# Hammerhead McColt (G4)

Hammerhead is the very large, pale mint-gray Earth-pony stallion among the **McColts**, the mountain-dwelling builders feuding with the Hooffields in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for his dark violet mane, bright green eyes, heavy build, and **bag-of-hammers cutie mark**. He shares a body design with Trouble Shoes, but is a different character.

[![Hammerhead McColt at far right with the McColt family; Hasbro/DHX television screencap](https://derpicdn.net/img/view/2023/3/7/3059091__safe_screencap_big%2Bdaddy%2Bmccolt_buzzsaw%2Bmccolt_crosscut%2Bmccolt_dusty%2Bmccolt_hacksaw%2Bmccolt_hammerhead%2Bmccolt_leadnail%2Bmccolt_locknut%2Bmccolt_piles%2Bmccol.jpg)](https://derpibooru.org/images/3059091)

*Show still from “The Hooffields and McColts”; production: Hasbro Studios/DHX Media. Hammerhead is the tall, pale-greenish stallion at the far right of the lower frame.*

**Name and continuity.** “Hammerhead McColt” is the character's **wiki/fandom identification**, not a name verified as spoken in the episode. The licensed Gameloft mobile game calls the matching pony **“McColt Carpenter”** and describes him as a carpenter and talented singer. These are names for the same design, not a secret identity or a different character. See the [Earth-pony stallion identification list](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) and [mobile-game character inventory](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/My_Little_Pony_Friendship_is_Magic_Wiki:Workshop/List_of_My_Little_Pony_(mobile_game)_characters/Sweet_Apple_Acres).

**Appearances and voice.** His verified television appearance is **“The Hooffields and McColts” (S5E23, 2015)**, as one of Big Daddy McColt's relatives. He is seen with the ensemble; no individually identified line or voice-actor credit was verified. The game's mention of singing does **not** establish a solo vocal performance in the show.

**Fan artwork:** [![Large ensemble of expressive pony faces including Hammerhead McColt; art by DoodleMarkyMark / chub-wub](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2024/11/30/3399395/medium.jpeg)](https://twibooru.org/3399395) — *“eyebrows”* (2022), credited to **DoodleMarkyMark / chub-wub** on the archived artwork page.

## Important moments

1. **The McColts form up for battle — “The Hooffields and McColts” (S5E23).** When the Hooffields' supposed peace-offering cake conceals an attack, Big Daddy orders his family into “Delta Force formation”; Hammerhead is recognizable among the assembled McColts, though he does not deliver the order. [Authorized episode listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/the-hooffields-and-mccolts/umc.cmc.8ven9s222p8yyfd2oi13pkj1?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) — **timestamp unavailable**.
2. **The families abandon their feud — “The Hooffields and McColts” (S5E23).** Fluttershy explains how the quarrel has harmed the valley's animals; Hammerhead's family makes peace with the Hooffields, enabling them to restore the land and rebuild homes together. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Hooffields_and_McColts) — **timestamp unavailable**.

*These are ensemble moments: the episode does not give Hammerhead a separate, named character arc.*
